## Load gene expression data

From GEO https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE158420
GSE158420_counts.txt.gz

Data was cleaned according to another script `GSE158420_geneexpression_prep.Rmd`

```{r,loaddat}

x <- readRDS("GSE158420_counts_fixed.rds")

x[1:6,1:5]

```

## Get reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gmt_import <- function(gmtfile) {
    genesetLines <- strsplit(readLines(gmtfile), "\t")
    genesets <- lapply(genesetLines, utils::tail, -2)
    names(genesets) <- unlist(lapply(genesetLines, head, 1))
    attributes(genesets)$originfile <- gmtfile
    genesets <- genesets[lapply(genesets,length)>0]
    if( any(duplicated(names(genesets))) ) {
        warning("Duplicated gene sets names detected")
    }
    genesets
}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

```

## Samplesheet set up

```{r,samplesheet}

ss <- as.data.frame(colnames(x))
rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
ss$patient <- factor(gsub("T","",gsub("N","",gsub("X","",ss[,1]))))
ss$tumor <- factor(grepl("T",ss[,1]))
ss[,1]=NULL
head(ss)

```

## Downsample

```{r,downsample_gsva_tc}

blah()

NPAT=3
i=1

gsva_tc <- function(NPAT,i,gs) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT,replace=FALSE)
  ssd <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd$patient))
  xd <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd)]
  xdf <- xd[which(rowMeans(xd) > 5),]
  y <- DGEList(counts = xdf)
  y <- normLibSizes(y) #edgeR
  expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
  param <- gsvaParam( expr = expr, geneSets = gs, kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = 5, maxSize = 5000)
  scores <- gsva(param)
  design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ssd)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)
  results <- limma::topTable( fit, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  confects <- limma_confects(fit, coef="tumorTRUE", fdr=0.05)
  m0 <- merge(results,confects$table,by.x=0,by.y="name")
  return(m0)
}


fgsea <- function(NPAT,i,gs) {
  set.seed(i*100)
  PATS <- sample(unique(ss$patient),NPAT,replace=FALSE)
  ssd <- ss[which(ss$patient %in% PATS),]
  ssd$patient <- as.factor(as.character(ssd$patient))
  xd <- x[,colnames(x) %in% rownames(ssd)]
  xdf <- xd[which(rowMeans(xd) > 5),]
  y <- DGEList(counts = xdf)
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + patient + tumor, data = ssd)
  v <- voom(y, design)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  results <- topTable(fit2, coef = "tumorTRUE", number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  stats <- results$t
  names(stats) <- rownames(results)
  fres <- fgsea(pathways=gs, stats=stats, minSize=5 )
  fres <- as.data.frame(fres)
  fres <- fres[order(fres$pval),]
  head(fres)
  return(fres)
}


```

## ORA

```{r,ora1}

upgenes <- rownames(subset(res,logFC>0 & FDR<0.05))
dngenes <- rownames(subset(res,logFC<0 & FDR<0.05))
bg <- rownames(res)

ores_up <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=upgenes,universe=bg,minSize=5)
ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=dngenes,universe=bg,minSize=5)

o_up <- subset(ores_up,padj<0.05)$pathway
o_dn <- subset(ores_dn,padj<0.05)$pathway


```

## Compare

```{r,pw_euler}

jaccard <- function(x,y) {
  length(intersect(x,y)) / length(union(x,y))
}

jaccard(gsva_up,tcup)


# GSVA vs FCS
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# ORA vs FCS
v1 <- list("ORA_up"=o_up, "ORA_dn"=o_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# GSVA vs ORA
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "ORA_up"=o_up,"ORA_dn"=o_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# Compare all
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn,
  "ORA_up"=o_up,"ORA_dn"=o_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

```

## Scatterplot

Merge GSVA-limma and FGSEA results tables.

```{r,scatter}

#head(results)
#head(fres)

m <- merge(fres,results,by.x="pathway",by.y=0)
head(m)
plot(m$ES,m$logFC,pch=19,cex=0.6)
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

plot(m$ES,m$logFC,pch=19,cex=0.6)
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)
m_sig1 <- subset(m,padj<0.05)
points(m_sig1$ES,m_sig1$logFC,col="red",pch=19,cex=0.6)
mtext("FGSEA sig points in red")

plot(m$ES,m$logFC,pch=19,cex=0.6)
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)
m_sig2 <- subset(m,adj.P.Val<0.05)
points(m_sig2$ES,m_sig2$logFC,col="blue",pch=19,cex=0.6)
mtext("GSVA sig points in blue")

plot(m$ES,m$logFC,pch=19,cex=0.6)
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)
m_sig3 <- subset(m,adj.P.Val<0.05 & padj<0.05)
points(m_sig1$ES,m_sig1$logFC,col="red",pch=19,cex=0.6)
points(m_sig2$ES,m_sig2$logFC,col="blue",pch=19,cex=0.6)
points(m_sig3$ES,m_sig3$logFC,col="orange",pch=19,cex=0.6)
mtext("FGSEA=red, GSVA=blue,both=orange")

```

## Directional question

Potential contradiction with logFC (GSVA) and ES (FGSEA).

```{r,direction_contradiction}

subset(m_sig2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC < 0 & ES > 0) |>
  kbl(caption="bottom-right pathways") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

subset(m_sig2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC > 0 & ES < 0) |>
  kbl(caption="top-left pathways") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

```
